title: Harpokrates in double crown
question: Which god is associated with the union of Lower and Upper Egypt?
evidence: This royal crown symbolizes the union of Lower and Upper Egypt, and highlights Horus’ role as the legitimate ruler of the entire land and his direct association with the king.

title: Mummy of the Lady Nefer
question: What is the name of the woman's mummy?
evidence: The mummified body of a woman named Nefer is not on view, but rests inside her closed coffin (which is displayed in gallery 130; see 20.4a, b).

title: Large Kneeling Statue of Hatshepsut
question: Which god was dedicated to by Hatshepsut?
evidence: On the upper terrace of Hatshepsut's temple at Deir el-Bahri, the central sanctuary was dedicated to the god Amun-Re, whose principal place of worship was Karnak temple, located across the Nile, on the east bank of the river.

title: Stela of Tatiaset
question: Which god is shown on one side of her stela?
evidence: One side of her stela shows the deceased being led by Anubis toward the seated statue of Ra-Harakhty.

title: Rishi coffin
question: Which god united with his father to ensure his rebirth?
evidence: In this text, the ba of Re, here identified as the son of Osiris, unites with the ba of his father to guarantee his rebirth.

title: Osiris inscribed for Harkhebit, son of Padikhonsu and Isetempermes
question: Where was this large Osiris dedicated?
evidence: This large Osiris was dedicated somewhere at Memphis.
